verdicts.reason: A: the logo is shrunk and jammed into the top-right corner against the 'NEW FLAVOR' badge. The badge is squashed into an ellipse that overlaps the cream circle, and the can has slipped off its cream backdrop, so it nearly disappears into the orange. The headline and CTA are strong. B: the badge is stretched into a thin sliver and its text breaks as 'NEW FLA VOR'. The can is also separated from the circle and reads poorly. The logo moves to the bottom, out of the original reading order, but it is clean, legible and doesn't collide with anything. B is marginally less broken.
